text: {"lessons":["Selling stocks simply because they have risen quickly can cut short further gains; I should reassess their prospects rather than react to my cost basis.","Holding losing stocks just to avoid realizing a loss is not a sound plan; I should review whether the reasons for owning them still hold.","A few months of account results are too little to judge my decisions, so I should check in periodically and make deliberate, balanced choices rather than trade from short-term moves."]}
